label: the relative participle: joining a clause to a noun
note: Chapter 90, closed by the same three atoms as ML-A1-PRON-08, which its own note pointed at. The Spanish inventory files the relative clause under subordination and this file answers both. See ML-A1-PRON-08 for the account: the describing form is one vowel sign off the end of a taught verb form, the clause goes in front of the noun, and there is no joining word at all.
